analysis.title: Playful Mustard Reward Landing Page
analysis.notes: A saturated mustard field dominates the composition, interrupted by a dark diagonal wedge and a floating 3D thumbs-up hand with an orange cuff. Oversized cream typography anchors the lower edge while compact pill navigation creates a polished, energetic landing-page hierarchy.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a polished 3D hero illustration of a stylized thumbs-up hand floating diagonally across a saturated mustard-yellow field. Give the hand a soft ivory sculpted form, rounded fingers, subtle ambient occlusion, and a vivid orange cuff with a small metallic button. Use smooth toy-like materials, soft directional lighting, gentle shadows, and a clean premium startup-art direction. Compose the hand in the upper-right area with generous negative space on the left and a dark charcoal geometric wedge entering from the lower-left. No text, logos, watermarks, or interface elements.
